description: This PHP source file defines the CompanyStructureService class within the OrangeHRM Admin Service module. It provides methods for managing organizational subunits, including CRUD operations, retrieving subunit trees, and handling subunit chains. It interacts with the CompanyStructureDao for database operations and uses traits for normalization.

classes.name: CompanyStructureService
classes.description: Service class for managing organizational structure, including CRUD operations on subunits and retrieving hierarchical data.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO instance for company structure, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setCompanyStructureDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance for company structure.

methods.name: getSubunitById
methods.description: Retrieves a subunit entity by its ID.

methods.name: addSubunit
methods.description: Adds a child subunit to a parent subunit.

methods.name: deleteSubunit
methods.description: Deletes a subunit and its children.

methods.name: setOrganizationName
methods.description: Sets the root organization name, updating the entire structure's root node.

methods.name: getSubunitTree
methods.description: Retrieves the full subunit hierarchy as an array.

methods.name: getSubunitArray
methods.description: Returns an array of subunits normalized for external use, excluding the root node.

methods.name: getSubunitChainById
methods.description: Returns the chain of subunit IDs from a given subunit up to the root.
